# MarsAI

> The development workflow V4 Company uses to build with AI agents, published as open source (Apache 2.0). Skills, agents and gates that take a change from problem to production: demo first, hardening after. Two plugins, `marsai-core` and `marsai-dev`, for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode.

The site is a single-page application. The pages below are plain text and say the same things.

## For an agent

- [Install instructions]({{site}}/install.md): how to install MarsAI in the coding agent you are running in, and what to tell the person afterward
- [First-use interview]({{site}}/onboarding.md): adapt MarsAI to the person's role, project, architecture and team before the first task
- [The flow]({{site}}/flow.md): the map of the flow, as the agent reads it (the `using-marsai` skill)
- [Glossary]({{site}}/glossary.md): the terms of the flow, in English and in Brazilian Portuguese

## Two ways to adopt it

- Start fast: install from `{{repo}}` as plugins (Claude Code) or with the installer (Codex, Cursor, OpenCode), following the install instructions above. Enough for one repository or one person.
- Scale to a team across many repositories: run `/marsai-core:home-repo` to set up a Home Repo where every session starts, with a pointer to each repository, a wiki, the team's Standards and skills in `.claude/`, updated with `git pull`. This is how V4 Company runs MarsAI today, with about 40 people across 80+ repositories ([ADR 0019](https://github.com/{{repo}}/blob/main/docs/adr/0019-sessions-start-in-the-home-repo.md)).
